One unfractionated injection per sample/mixture; no fractionation described.

claims.value: 04-HL: control = SILAC heavy, KO = SILAC light; 05-LH and 06-LH: control = SILAC light, KO = SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: Preprint Methods: "Two samples were heavy labeled T126AKO cells and light control labeled cells, while a third consisted of a label switch." Files: two LH, one HL. Data check (proteinGroups Ratio H/L normalized): complex I subunits median log2 H/L +0.52 in HL vs -0.52/-0.51 in LH_1/LH_2; TMEM126A H/L 4.64 in HL and 0.08 in LH_2 (absent in the KO heavy channel); CKMT1A (paper: most upregulated in KO) H/L 0.30 in HL vs 2.68/2.71 in LH. So heavy = KO in LH runs, heavy = control in HL run.

Fig 1B: "protein abundance in T126AKO mitochondria relative to control"; KO generated in HEK293T by CRISPR/Cas9 (preprint Methods). The KO clone used for Fig 1B is not stated, so no clone id is given. Control = HEK293T without TMEM126A editing (controls of the HEK293T KO lines).
n=3 SILAC experiments (Fig 1B legend); each mixture made from separately labelled cultures (two forward, one label switch).
Preprint: HEK293T (ATCC; CRL-3216). The KO line was made in-house; no repository.
All three raw headers: "Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS", serial QEPLUSSN03110L. PRIDE protocol lists "Orbitrap Q Exactive plus, Elite or Eclipse".

limitations: Partial scope: the 36 pulse-chase SILAC runs (Fig 3F/3G; 201119_Daniella_DH-1445_01..36.raw, Orbitrap Eclipse targeted method "Dani Target.meth") are NOT annotated. Their MaxQuant experiments are named only 01..36, and the per-run design (cell line, pulse/chase time point, IP vs input, replicate) is described only in the PNAS 2021 paper, whose full text, figure legends and SI are not retrievable (PMC body not open access; Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500; pnas.org and pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov served bot checks, not bypassed; Unpaywall only points to the bioRxiv v1 preprint, which predates the pulse-chase experiment). Recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

Full PNAS text not available; methods come from bioRxiv v1 (10.1101/2020.09.18.303255), the PRIDE protocols, MaxQuant outputs and raw headers. The preprint says the instrument was an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos; the raw headers (authoritative) show Q Exactive Plus (SILAC) and Orbitrap Elite (AE-MS).
